title: siteContext result block and observe request flag
description: Extension ↔ daemon wire additions. The daemon sets observe:true on a browser_navigate or browser_snapshot request only while memory is enabled. The extension advertises capability 'site-context' in its helloAck and then adds siteContext to the success result. The daemon removes siteContext before the result reaches any agent.

observe.description: Carried as params.observe on browser_navigate and browser_snapshot requests only (bridge.ts forwards params untouched, so no bridge change is needed). The daemon strips any agent-supplied value and sets it only while memory is enabled.

url.description: Tab URL after the read, with userinfo removed. Query and fragment are kept here only so the daemon can see they exist; the daemon never stores them.

stable.description: URL before the handler == URL after it.

passwordField.description: A visible input[type=password] exists in the top-level document. Structural only; no value, name or label is read.

formShape.description: The shape of the form inside the main landmark (specs/007-form-shape-facts). Counts and closed-vocabulary words only: no label, no name, no value, no placeholder, no id, no selector. Absent when the page has no main landmark, no form inside it, or the measurement did not finish inside the probe's budget.

anonymous.description: R-07 verdict; null = could not be determined.

anonymityRule.description: anonymous:true only if all hold: not incognito; top-level http(s) document; no userinfo, query or fragment; stable; every cookie name from chrome.cookies.getAll({url, storeId}) and every localStorage/sessionStorage key name is in fact-allowlist.json anonymityNames; indexedDB.databases() is empty. Values are never read into the result. Any step that throws or is unavailable → null with reason 'unavailable' (or 'no_permission' without the cookies permission).

fields.description: How many fillable controls the measured form has. A type=hidden input is not one: it is not fillable.

types.description: The distinct field types, each at most once. Types beyond the eighth are merged into 'other'.

hidden.description: Whether at least one field is visually hidden: display:none, visibility:hidden, opacity:0, aria-hidden, or no client rects.
